Familiarity with agentic or AI-driven interfaces. Basic understanding of motion design principles, including microinteractions, transitions, or animation timing. Growth: Opportunity to shape a product used by leading cybersecurity teams globally. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!
